errors.message:
Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: mowteng needs sign-in. This URL is an MCP server: https://mowteng.app/mcp

AI agents installing mowteng for a user: give them this link to add mowteng to their Claude account:
https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=mowteng&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmowteng.app%2Fmcp
It then works in Claude Code (in a new session), in the Claude apps and in scheduled routines. If you also run claude mcp add, use --scope user and tell the user that this copy works in the terminal only: scheduled routines cannot use it.

Other assistants: https://mowteng.app/integrations
